speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning. I need to understand the timeline of these symptoms: did the leg weakness and gait unsteadiness start before or after you noticed the forgetfulness and paranoid behavior? Also, have you experienced any recent falls involving head trauma?

speaker: Patient
text: 44-year-old male. The patient's daughter reports a 1-week history of right leg weakness, unsteady gait, and multiple falls. Over the past 6 months, the patient has been increasingly forgetful, losing his way on familiar routes and facing difficulties operating simple kitchen appliances. He has also been paranoid, agitated, and restless recently.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary CNS Lymphoma. The subacute onset of cognitive decline, personality changes, and focal motor deficits in a 44-year-old male is highly suggestive of an infiltrative brain process. I will order an MRI of the brain with contrast to look for lesions, particularly in the temporal lobes or cerebellum. REQUEST IMAGES: Brain_MRI_with_contrast. REQUEST TEST: MRI_Report_Review.
